title: Sable and the Autopsy
author: Paloma Pemberton
blurb: Gideon Halloran, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
